ai.title: Adoption watcher tracks package installs after ad clicks
ai.summary: A new adoption watcher in `cli/src/ads/ad-adoption.ts` monitors agent shell commands for package installs matching the vendor of a clicked ad, reporting a `postClick` engagement record when a match is found. The watcher parses commands in memory using `parseInstalledPackages` to extract package names from `npm`, `bun`, `pnpm`, and `yarn` install verbs, limiting the scan to the first 4096 characters and 64 packages per command to remain cheap. Wired into the ad click path via `armAdAdoptionWatch` in `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts`, the watcher is bounded to 8 concurrent watches with lazy expiration based on `AD_MS_CAP`.
